title: Systematic Evaluation of Machine-Generated Reasoning and PHQ-9 Labeling for Depression Detection Using Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing false positive and false negative detection rates on social media texts that contain explicit depression-related keywords (Mentioned Depression) versus texts that use implicit expressions (No Mention of Depression).
Evaluating model accuracy on subtasks designed to determine whether the text describes the speaker's own mental state or refers to other individuals and general knowledge.
